Superman Absolute

Description

Sideshow and Iron Studios are proud to announce the latest from the Art Scale 1:10 line - the Superman Absolute 1:10 Scale Statue!

From DC Comics, this Superman Art Scale Statue is limited edition, highly detailed, and hand-painted. 

Don't miss your chance to add this Superman Absolute 1:10 Scale Statue to your DC Comics collectibles display!
